200.description: text/event-stream: `stage`, `progress`, then `result` or `error`, and always `done` last. Payloads: StageEvent, ProgressEvent, UploadResult, ErrorEvent, DoneEvent.
text/event-stream: `stage` events (searching -> ranking -> writing -> checking; finished steps carry data.step), then `answer` or `error`, and always `done` last.
text/event-stream: `progress` (stage evaluation, done/total, detail), `stage` per run, `error`, and `done` last. Then GET /api/eval/latest.

post.description: Rebuild every active document with the current embedding model and chunk settings.

get.description:
Local models only (Ollama, or the server set in .env), whichever provider is on: the
Settings page lists them when its "Use local models" toggle is on.

post.description:
Every answer and embedding model this API key can use, each marked free tier or not.
With gemini.free_tier_only (the default) the page greys out the paid-only ones, and
saving one is refused.

put.description:
Check the key against the Gemini API, then save it in .env (git-ignored). The key is
never written to config.yaml and never returned by the API.
